# pve_sdn_fabric_openfabric (Resource)

Manages an OpenFabric SDN fabric (`/cluster/sdn/fabrics/fabric`, section protocol `openfabric`) with its per-node member entries (`/cluster/sdn/fabrics/node/{fabric_id}`). Changes stay pending and take effect only after the `pve_sdn_apply` action runs.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright (c) HashiCorp, Inc.

# OpenFabric SDN fabric with one node member. Changes stay pending until
# the `pve_sdn_apply` action pushes them cluster-wide.
resource "pve_sdn_fabric_openfabric" "openfabric1" {
  fabric_id      = "ofab1"
  ip_prefix      = "10.0.0.0/24"
  hello_interval = 10

  nodes = [
    {
      node_id = "pve1"
      ip      = "10.0.0.1"
      ip6     = null
      interfaces = [
        {
          name             = "ens19"
          ip               = "10.0.0.1/24"
          ip6              = null
          hello_multiplier = 3
        },
      ]
    },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `fabric_id` (String) The fabric identifier (PVE `pve-sdn-fabric-id`: 2 - 8 characters of letters, digits, or hyphens, starting and ending alphanumeric). Changing this value forces recreation.

### Optional

- `csnp_interval` (Number) Complete Sequence Number PDU interval in seconds. Must be between 1 and 600.
- `hello_interval` (Number) Hello packet interval in seconds. Must be between 1 and 600.
- `ip6_prefix` (String) IPv6 prefix (CIDR) node addresses are drawn from, e.g. `fd00::/64`.
- `ip_prefix` (String) IPv4 prefix (CIDR) node addresses are drawn from, e.g. `10.0.0.0/24`.
- `nodes` (Attributes List) Per-node member entries of the fabric. Each entry joins the named cluster node into the OpenFabric fabric. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--nodes))
- `route_filter` (String) Prefix list (see `pve_sdn_prefix_list`) used to filter routes installed into the kernel routing table.

### Read-Only

- `digest` (String) Configuration digest of the fabric; changes whenever the fabric configuration changes.

<a id="nestedatt--nodes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `nodes`

Required:

- `node_id` (String) The cluster node name.

Optional:

- `interfaces` (Attributes List) Network interfaces participating in OpenFabric on this node. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--nodes--interfaces))
- `ip` (String) IPv4 address of this node inside the fabric.
- `ip6` (String) IPv6 address of this node inside the fabric.

<a id="nestedatt--nodes--interfaces"></a>
### Nested Schema for `nodes.interfaces`

Required:

- `name` (String) Name of the network interface (e.g. `ens19`).

Optional:

- `hello_multiplier` (Number) OpenFabric hello multiplier of the interface. Must be between 2 and 100.
- `ip` (String) IPv4 address (CIDRv4) for this interface, e.g. `10.0.0.1/24`.
- `ip6` (String) IPv6 address (CIDRv6) for this interface.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Copyright (c) HashiCorp, Inc.
# Import an existing OpenFabric fabric by its identifier:
terraform import pve_sdn_fabric_openfabric.openfabric1 openfabric1
```
